title: Agreement with the affine-line route on affine space
statement:
Use the finite-coefficient purity conventions [def-pur-conventions], with $A=\Lambda=A_{E,n}$ for any $n\geq1$. Let $Y$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], let $d\geq0$, let $p_d:X=\mathbf A^d_Y\to Y$ be the projection [def-sbc-affine-space], and let $K\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,A)$ [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. Use the specified pro-etale twists [def-coefficient-twists-detailed] and exceptional inverse images [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image].

The affine comparison at every coefficient level is specified as follows. For an affine-line projection $p:\mathbf A^1_S\to S$ with standard compactification $j:\mathbf A^1_S\hookrightarrow\mathbf P^1_S$, $q:\mathbf P^1_S\to S$, define $I_S:Rp_!A(1)[2]\to A_S$ by $Rq_*j_!A(1)[2]\to Rq_*A(1)[2]\xrightarrow{t_q}A_S$. Here $t_q$ is the ordinary etale projective-line trace [def-amb-p1-trace], formed with $\mu_{\ell^r}^{\mathrm{et}}\otimes_{\mathbf Z/\ell^r}A$ for any $r\geq1$ such that $\ell^rA=0$, and realized on the specified pro-etale Tate twist by [lem-amb-cartier-kummer-map, lem-sf-class-compact-support-comparison]. Define $\Gamma_{p,K}$ as the exceptional transpose of
$$
Rp_!Lp^*K(1)[2]\xrightarrow{\mathrm{PF}^{-1}}K\otimes_A^LRp_!A(1)[2]\xrightarrow{1_K\otimes I_S}K,
$$
using the projection map [def-exchange-projection]. These maps are independent of $r$. Put $\Gamma_{p_0,K}=1_K$ and define $\Gamma_{p_d,K}$ as the ordered composite of these $d$ affine-line maps, with the exceptional-composition and twist-additivity isomorphisms as in [def-pur-affine-space-comparison]. On the domain $e(E/\mathbf Q_\ell)\mid n$ of [def-pur-affine-line-datum], these are exactly the named maps [def-pur-affine-line-purity-comparison, thm-pur-affine-line-purity, cor-pur-affine-space-purity]; the displayed construction specifies their extension to all $n\geq1$.

Specify the diagonal/DNC normalization in the smooth purity map [def-pur-smooth-purity-map] as follows, as in the model paragraph of the unit. Put $W=X\times_YX$, with projections $p_1,p_2$ and diagonal $\Delta$, and let $\alpha:C(p_1,\Delta)\xrightarrow{\sim}\omega_{p_d}$ be [lem-pur-diagonal-base-change]. Let $N=N_{\Delta/W}$ and let $\delta:C(p_1,\Delta)\xrightarrow{\sim}C(\pi_N,0_N)$ be the normalized comparison [thm-pur-dnc-invariance], with section invariants [def-pur-section-invariant]. On the normal bundle use the inverse of the integration-transposed comparison of [thm-amb-vector-bundle-purity], with integration [def-amb-vector-integration], transported by [thm-sf-ambient-adjoint-class]. Pulling it back along $0_N$ and restricting the twist gives $\beta:C(\pi_N,0_N)\xrightarrow{\sim}A_X(d)[2d]$. The dualizing orientation used in the middle arrow of the smooth purity map is $\vartheta_p=\beta\delta\alpha^{-1}:\omega_p\xrightarrow{\sim}A_X(d)[2d]$; that middle arrow uses $\vartheta_p^{-1}$.

Then this smooth purity map equals $\Gamma_{p_d,K}$ as a morphism
$$
Lp_d^*K(d)[2d]\longrightarrow Rp_d^!K.
$$
For $d=0$ both maps are $1_K$.

proof.text: Choose a bounded etale finite-Tor presentation (Ke, eK) of the original intrinsic K, with its lower bound: [lem-sf-proetale-constructible-origin] gives a bounded constructible etale representative and [lem-sf-comparison-tor-amplitude] its finite Tor interval. The unique specification of the ordered affine map, independent of the presentation by [lem-pur-affine-ordered-integration-transposes], gives it as the intrinsic realization of projectionAffineInPresentation at (Ke, eK) [def-pur-projection-purity-coordinates]. The HEq specification identifies projectionSmoothIntrinsic with the recorded smoothPurityMap [def-pur-smooth-purity-map].

By [lem-pur-projection-intrinsic-presentation] the smooth purity map is the intrinsic realization of the same presentation composite (it transports the coordinate equation, which combines the unit-orientation comparison and the tensor integration equation). This gives the claimed equality, also in rank zero.

blueprint_update.statement:
In the purity conventions of [def-pur-conventions],
for the projection $p_d:\mathbf A^d_Y\to Y$ the smooth purity map
$\gamma_{p_d,K}$ of [def-pur-smooth-purity-map] equals the
affinity-space purity comparison of [cor-pur-affine-space-purity],
i.e. the ordered composite of the $d$ affinity-line purity maps of
[thm-pur-affine-line-purity].

proof.text:
Both maps are canonical and, by [thm-pur-composition-coherence]
and [prop-pur-affine-space-purity-compatibilities], they are
compatible with the tower of affine projections. It therefore suffices
to compare them after restriction to a geometric fiber of $Y$, where
both are determined by the integration that normalizes them: the
dualizing-object identification of [def-pur-smooth-purity-map] for
$p_d$ comes from the deformation of the diagonal $\Delta$ and the
standard-pair computation of [lem-pur-dnc-section-geometry](4) – the
diagonal of the standard pair $(\mathbf A^{2d}_Y,\Delta)$ has normal
bundle the trivial rank-$d$ bundle $T_{p_d}$, and the DNC invariance of
[thm-pur-dnc-invariance] is the identity on the standard pair – where
$0^*\omega_{\mathbf A^d/Y}\cong\Lambda(d)[2d]$ is the vector-bundle
purity of [cor-pur-vector-bundle-purity], the adjoint of the
integration $t_\pi$ of [def-amb-vector-integration]; on the trivial
bundle $t_\pi$ is the ordered affine-space integration, the iterate of
the projective-line trace normalized by $t_q(c_1(\mathcal O(1)))=1$.
The affinity-space purity of [cor-pur-affine-space-purity] is the
ordered composite of the affinity-line comparisons, each the adjoint of
the same projective-line-normalized trace. So both are normalized by the
same integration, the one sending the product of the Cartier classes of
the coordinate hyperplanes to $1$ (and the product of the Kummer
boundaries of the coordinates to $(-1)^d$). The two
assemblies differ only by the canonical reassociations of the package
(the Koszul signs are $+1$, since all shift factors are of even
degree, by [prop-pur-affine-space-purity-compatibilities]); hence
the maps agree.
